the board.max play: 💎 3u - the hockey Dog of the Day when the dog is rested, the favorite played last night and the dog score is 8+ (several things agreeing, never one factor); a label on the Dog, never an extra pick; about 17 a hockey season; off at 25 graded under 44% won (11/16)
the board.leans: NONE - the engine posts no leans and keeps no leans record (the owner, 11/16: leans out of existence); every pick on the board carries units
